For years, teams measured AI success through adoption and token consumption. Katie McDonald explains why AI usage metrics alone don't capture business value, how tokenmaxxing and token minimization both miss the point, and why successful organizations are shifting toward outcome-based AI strategies. Learn how AI efficiency, model orchestration, and value maxing are changing the next chapter of AI adoption.
